verses.text: For the music director. David, the LORD’s servant, sang this song to the LORD when the LORD rescued him from all his enemies and from Saul. He said, “I love you, LORD, my strength.”
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my rescuer. My God is the rock where I take refuge, my shield, my saving horn, and my stronghold.
I call to the LORD, who deserves praise, and he saves me from my enemies.
The ropes of death closed around me, and floods of wickedness terrified me.
The ropes of Sheol wrapped around me. Death’s traps lay in my path.
In my distress I called to the LORD and cried out to my God. He heard me from his temple. My cry reached his ears.
The earth shook and trembled. The foundations of the mountains shook because he was angry.
Smoke rose from his nostrils. A fire that devours came from his mouth and set coals ablaze.
He bent the heavens down and came to earth, with thick darkness under his feet.
He rode on a cherub and flew. He soared on the wings of the wind.
He hid himself in darkness, making a shelter around himself from dark waters and thick clouds.
From the brightness before him came thick clouds, hailstones, and burning coals.
The LORD thundered in the sky. The Most High raised his voice with hailstones and burning coals.
He shot his arrows and scattered his enemies. He sent lightning bolts and drove them away.
The channels of the waters came into view. The world’s foundations lay bare when you rebuked them, LORD, at the blast of breath from your nostrils.
He reached down from above, took hold of me, and pulled me out of deep waters.
He rescued me from my powerful enemy and from those who hated me, because they were stronger than I was.
They came for me when disaster struck, but the LORD held me up.
He brought me into a wide-open place. He rescued me because he delighted in me.
The LORD rewarded me for doing what was right. He repaid me because my hands were clean.
I’ve followed the ways of the LORD and haven’t turned away from my God to do evil.
I kept all his judgments in front of me and never put his laws aside.
I lived blamelessly before him and kept myself from wrongdoing.
So the LORD has rewarded me for doing what is right, because he saw that my hands were clean.
You show mercy to those who show mercy and deal with integrity toward those who live with integrity.
You show yourself pure to the pure and outsmart those who are crooked.
You rescue people who are suffering, and you bring down those who look at others with pride.
You light my lamp, LORD. My God lights up my darkness.
With you I can charge through a troop. With my God I can leap over a wall.
God’s way is perfect. The LORD’s word has stood the test. He shields all who take refuge in him.
Who is God besides the LORD? Who is a rock besides our God,
the God who gives me strength and makes my way blameless?
He gives me feet like a deer’s and sets me securely on the heights.
He trains my hands for battle, so my arms can bend a bronze bow.
You’ve given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand holds me up, and your gentleness has made me great.
You’ve made room for me to take wide steps, and my feet haven’t slipped.
I’ll chase my enemies and catch them. I won’t turn back until they’re finished.
I’ll strike them so they can’t get back up. They’ll fall beneath my feet.
You gave me strength for battle and brought down everyone who rose against me.
You made my enemies turn and run so I could cut down those who hated me.
They cried out, but no one saved them. They even called to the LORD, but he didn’t answer.
I crushed them like dust in the wind and threw them out like mud from the streets.
You rescued me from the people’s quarrels and made me head over nations. People I’ve never known will serve me.
As soon as they hear of me, they’ll obey. People from other lands will submit to me.
They’ll lose heart and come trembling out of their strongholds.
The LORD lives! Bless my rock! Let the God who saves me be lifted high,
the God who avenges me and brings peoples under my rule.
He rescues me from my enemies. You raise me above those who rise against me and save me from violent people.
So I’ll thank you among the nations, LORD, and sing praises to your name.
He gives his king great victories and shows faithful love to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
